'''Duracables''' were a type of cable used during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Four duracables were used to hold up a [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]] [[Nebulon-R Racer]] swoop bike in the [[Binary Bar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Venaari]]. The cables were severed by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Sienn Sconn]] who shot them with a [[wrist laser]] gauntlet, causing the bike to swing down into an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] attempting to shoot at him in the bar and pin him to the floor.<ref name="Ooak" />

==Behind the scenes==
Duracables first appeared in the short story [[One of a Kind (short story)|''One of a kind'']] written by [[Paul Danner]] and originally published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|5]] in [[1995]] and then later republished as a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article in [[2004]].
